skill_name: Explain why some people like to watch horror movies.
workflow: Some people find it exciting to experience the thrilling and suspenseful atmosphere of horror movies. They can release the fear and tension within themselves, without having to face any real-life dangers. The adrenaline rush caused by the intense scenes also gives some people a feeling of being alive.
